summary: Decode person mission-step assignees while keeping claimants and wake assignments agent-only

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes; this updates the published client JSON schema.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Person assignees decode for mission steps and current-step run summaries. Claimants remain agent-only, as do MissionWake assignments; no claim-path change. Older strict clients may reject person assignee references; mixed client versions were not tested.

manual.detail: No installation or data migration steps required; consumers validating mission-step assignees should use the updated contract.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery changes; older contract validators can still reject person assignee references.
